question.question: When Vagabond takes a hit, which item must be chosen, where does it go, does its face change, and can already-damaged items absorb another hit?

expected.expected_answer: Choose one undamaged item and move it to Damaged box, keeping its current face. Cannot select an already-damaged item to absorb another hit. With no undamaged items remaining, ignore remaining hits.

source_passages.section: Actions — Vagabond (9), complete Pawn and items damage procedure
source_passages.quotation:
**Pawn and items:** Pawn is not a warrior, cannot rule or block rule, and cannot be removed. An enemy effect removing **all enemy pieces** from its clearing instead damages **three items**. Items may be face up (ready) or face down (exhausted), and independently undamaged or damaged. To exhaust for an action, choose a face-up **undamaged** item and flip it down. Damaged items cannot pay actions.

Face-up tea/coins/bags in Satchel immediately move to empty matching track space if possible; each track holds at most three of its type. Exhausting an item on track sends it to Satchel. Boots/swords/crossbows/torch/hammers are gained face up in Satchel. Damaging an item sends it to Damaged box **without changing its face**. One hit damages one undamaged item of your choice; ignore excess hits when none remain.

answer.ruling: Each hit damages one undamaged item of the Vagabond's choice. The damaged item goes to the Damaged box.
Damaging an item does not change whether it is face up or face down.

answer.part: Already damaged items and excess hits
answer.ruling: An already-damaged item cannot absorb another hit. If no undamaged items remain, ignore excess hits.
